record.field: Read all BoMs. Create new BoMs freely (manual or Excel import). Modify or delete existing BoMs only while they are not used in any Manufacturing Order or while a related ECO is open. Apply ECOs they validated.

Controls which users can see and execute BoM maintenance server actions (e.g. route synchronisation, dependency setup). Does NOT bypass PLM flow: members still require an ECO to edit production BoMs directly. The server actions themselves use sudo() internally for their specific operations.
